name: エッジアンチエイリアシング (映像) 解析
description: Analyzes edge antialiasing in 動画 frames
algorithm: Edge Antialiasing (Video) — ピクセルレベル空間分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes edge anti-aliasing patterns in video for deepfake detection:

1. **エッジ検出&分類**: Edges are detected using multi-directional gradient operators and classified by type: natural edges (object boundaries, texture), compression edges (DCT block boundaries), and potential artifact edges (generation boundaries).

2. **Anti-Aliasingプロファイル分析**: The sub-pixel transition profile at each edge is measured. Real camera capture produces edges with specific anti-aliasing characteristics determined by the optical low-pass filter and sensor sampling. AI-generated content often produces different edge profiles — either over-sharp (no optical AA) or artificially smoothed.

3. **エッジ一貫性検証**: All edges in authentic video share the same optical pipeline, producing consistent anti-aliasing characteristics. The method compares edge profiles between face regions and background. Deepfake composites may show different AA characteristics in generated face regions versus original footage.

4. **時間的エッジ安定性**: Edge anti-aliasing should remain consistent across frames for stationary edges. The method tracks AA profiles temporally — deepfake generators may produce inconsistent sub-pixel edge rendering frame-to-frame, creating a temporal AA flicker not present in authentic video.

5. **解像度境界検出**: The method detects boundaries between regions of different effective resolution by analyzing edge sharpness gradients. Face-swap deepfakes may produce faces with different effective resolution than the background, creating a detectable resolution discontinuity at the face boundary.
parameters:
分析タイプ: ピクセル
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through edge antialiasing (動画) analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
